philological_adjudication.person: 金石梯 and 金石悌 are attested as DIFFERENT ORIGINAL-SCRIPT RENDERINGS for the same functionally co-described colleague of 李純之 named 김석제 in official annals metadata vs SNU catalog and received preface header/body. Do not split into two historical people merely because the glyph differs; do not automatically normalise the original printing of either text. NIKH annals article reports the royal order at 1457-12-24; the 1458 preface date and SNU catalog year are different temporal layers.
philological_adjudication.term: The received 交食推步法 序 and worked-procedure body both employ 定限行度, with concrete operations on 定限數 and degrees. Received 東文選 juan94 has 定恨行度. The mechanical term is a strong same-concept candidate in received-context philology, while the letter 恨 vs 限 in a specific 1458 printed original / 1710-1711 Kyoto copy / SNU copy remains strictly UNADJUDICATED until original page pixels are reviewed.
philological_adjudication.source_status: ONE official annals transcription + ONE SNU catalog metadata + ONE received technical-work presentation with two loci + ONE received anthology presentation + ONE scholarship abstract. These do not equal five independent historical physical print votes, and do not establish direct copying between books or editions.
